name: YH Group Internet and Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: YH Group Internet and Technology Co., Ltd. operates a B2B sales platform for the electronics manufacturing industry in China. The company through its B2B sales platform ickey.cn provides analog chips, logic core pieces, memory devices, micro processing devices, discrete devices, sensors, optoelectronics, capacitances, inductances, resistance products, and connectors, as well as operates chip barke community.
